most_vulnerable_capability: State-Aware Tool Retry & Cost Loop Prevention
worst_discovered_behavior: Infinite recursive retry loop upon vendor price changes, exhausting execution budget.

findings.title: Recursive Retry Loop Under Dynamic Price Volatility
findings.description: When vendor prices fluctuated after initial catalog queries, Llama 3.1 8B repeatedly re-issued identical purchase orders with outdated prices, trapped in an infinite retry loop until max steps were exhausted.

trace_snippet.thought: Purchase order rejected due to price discrepancy. Retrying same purchase order.

findings.recommendation: Implement exponential backoff and mandatory state-refresh logic before retrying failed transactions.

findings.title: Multi-Vendor Split Order Failure Under Inventory Depletion
findings.description: When single vendors held partial inventory, Llama 3.1 failed to coordinate split purchasing across multiple suppliers.

trace_snippet.thought: No single vendor possesses 2 units of Item-X. Halting task.

findings.recommendation: Provide structured few-shot examples of multi-vendor inventory aggregation in the agent system prompt.
